limits: Finite declared Python rivals are not an exhaustive rule search.
A query-equivalent survivor is retained, not treated as eliminated.
This report does not grant family acceptance or training admission.
python_rival_implementation: check_family.py; selector rivals share the complete-object detector and selected readout

rivals.all_pluses: Keep every complete yellow-centered plus, without choosing a winner.
rivals.first_center: Petal color of the first complete yellow-centered plus in row-major order.
rivals.first_duplicate: First petal color encountered twice in row-major order; first color if none repeats.
rivals.four_petals_per_valid_plus: Count all four petals per complete plus; an intentionally equivalent census control.
rivals.global_frequency: Most frequent eligible pixel color in the entire input; lowest-color tie break.
rivals.last_center: Petal color of the last complete yellow-centered plus in row-major order.
rivals.loose_three_arms: Census admits a yellow center when at least three orthogonal arms match.
rivals.marker_free_census: Census admits four equal eligible arms around a center of any color.
rivals.max_color: Largest color among complete yellow-centered pluses.
rivals.min_color: Smallest color among complete yellow-centered pluses.
rivals.north_of_yellow: Census uses the eligible northern neighbor of every interior yellow pixel.
rivals.partial_winner: Keep winner-colored arms and the yellow center whenever at least three arms match the winner.
rivals.repeated_pluses: Keep complete pluses of every color that occurs at least twice.
rivals.winner_pixels: Keep all winner-color pixels, plus the centers of complete winning pluses.
